column3: BSB renders “the word of the beginning of Christ” as “the elementary teachings about Christ.”
BSB starts a new sentence: “In the end it will be burned.”
BSB moves “Even though we speak like this” to the front.
BSB follows the critical text with “your work and the love,” without the Textus Receptus “labor of.”
BSB renders “toward the full assurance of the hope” as “in order to make your hope sure.”
BSB renders “multiplying I will multiply you” as “multiply your descendants.”
BSB starts a new sentence (“He has become”).
